name: Pointer- and Epoch-Based Reclamation Benchmark Suite
description: A benchmark suite and reference implementation to evaluate performance (throughput, latency, memory overhead) of pointer- and epoch-based memory reclamation algorithms.
evaluation_method: throughput (operations/sec), latency (microseconds/op), and memory overhead (bytes) measurement
general_score_metric: throughput (operations per second) as primary metric (with latency and memory overhead reported)
typical_sota_score: varies widely by algorithm and hardware; no single SOTA
reputation: Well-regarded reference suite in the concurrent-systems community for evaluating pointer- and epoch-based reclamation algorithms.
notes: Non-ML / non-LLM systems benchmark; results are highly hardware- and workload-dependent. Microbenchmark-style tests may not reflect application-level behavior; reproducibility requires matching hardware and workloads.
